 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Rare colors mark the special crossings of the overlaid lattice.
    rare = {v for v, n in counts.items() if n <= h * w * 0.10}
    marked = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] in rare]
    rows = sorted({r for r, _ in marked})
    cols = sorted({c for _, c in marked})
    matrix = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    if len(matrix) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return matrix
    out = []
    for r in range(len(matrix) - 1):
        outrow = []
        for c in range(len(cols) - 1):
            block = [matrix[r][c], matrix[r][c+1], matrix[r+1][c], matrix[r+1][c+1]]
            outrow.append(block[0] if block.count(block[0]) == 4 else background)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
"
}
